sections.subheading: Revolutionize How Your Myotherapy Practice Operates
sections.paragraph: At VirtualAssistant.com.au, our AI Virtual Receptionist is purpose-built for myotherapists and hands-on therapy professionals. It answers calls immediately, handles scheduling, provides detailed information about your services, and ensures every client interaction feels professional and personal.

sections.subheading: Focus on Treatments, Not Admin Tasks
sections.paragraph: Our AI Receptionist takes the pressure off your front desk by managing routine admin tasks. It can handle appointment bookings, reschedules, cancellations, reminders, and common client queries in natural conversation — giving you more time to focus on client care.

sections.subheading: Never Miss a Call or Booking Again
sections.paragraph: Whether you’re in session with a client or your reception is unattended, our AI Receptionist steps in to handle calls and inquiries instantly. It answers questions about treatment types, duration, and availability, then confirms bookings directly in your calendar. Your clients are always looked after — even when you’re hands-on.

whyChoose.heading: Why Myotherapists Choose VirtualAssistant.com.au
whyChoose.description: Our AI Virtual Receptionist is crafted for the unique workflow of Australian myotherapists. It integrates seamlessly with your existing booking and calendar systems, manages calls and appointments efficiently, and ensures your clinic maintains a professional image at all times. Let our AI manage the admin — so you can focus on delivering exceptional hands-on care.

leftBox.heading: Streamlined Follow-Up and Client Management
leftBox.description: After each treatment, myotherapists can easily add notes, record voice memos that are transcribed and summarized, and upload documents or photos linked to the client’s record. All data is securely organized in your dashboard for easy access, ensuring smooth follow-ups, continuity of care, and a clear client history.
